label: NFC Scan Simulator
info:
Simulates NFC card scans for virtual cards that match the seeded members.

Card → Member mapping (from tools/seeds/user.sql):
  card001 → Alice Martin   (member1@veltro.gym, member_profile_id=1)
  card002 → Bob Johnson    (member2@veltro.gym, member_profile_id=2)
  card003 → Chloe Bernard  (member3@veltro.gym, member_profile_id=3)
  card004 → David Moreau   (member4@veltro.gym, member_profile_id=4)
  card005 → Emma Petit     (member5@veltro.gym, member_profile_id=5)

All five cards have status=ACTIVE in the seed data.
Each button toggles IN→OUT→IN on successive clicks (flow context per card).

Prerequisite: set the VELTRO_JWT environment variable to a valid admin JWT.

name: Toggle IN/OUT per card

label: Machine Session Injector
info:
Injects randomized machine workout sessions for seeded members.

Member IDs match auth.app_user.id from tools/seeds/auth.sql:
  memberId 1 → Alice Martin   (member1@veltro.gym)
  memberId 2 → Bob Johnson    (member2@veltro.gym)
  memberId 3 → Chloe Bernard  (member3@veltro.gym)

Values are randomized within realistic ranges:
  durationMinutes: 20–90 min
  caloriesBurned:  200–800 kcal
  avgHeartRate:    110–175 bpm
  distanceKm:      1.0–15.0 km

name: Randomize values
Format response
